data.notes: Austin Wood reports that Dallas Office of Special Events canceled the planned Sept. 10 anti-Trump march permit; a Dallas Police Department spokesperson confirmed the cancellation and said DPD preferred organizers bypass the special-event permit process and work directly with DPD. This is the local Dallas report underlying the permit-process claim chain and should not be generalized beyond the quoted permit/coordination facts.
data.title: Dallas cancels permit for anti-Trump protest 1 week before GOP convention begins (Dallas Observer, 2026-09-02)
